cases.purpose: Compare procps batch bytes on a targeted slabdata and summary fixture.
cases.setup_script:
/usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --mount /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c '
/usr/bin/mount -n --bind "$PWD/slabinfo" /proc/slabinfo || exit 91
/usr/bin/cmp slabinfo /proc/slabinfo || exit 92
/usr/bin/slabtop -o > "$HOME/slab-control.out" 2> "$HOME/slab-control.err" || exit 93
s=$(< "$HOME/slab-control.out")
[[ $s == *fxalpha* && $s == *fxbeta* && $s == *fxcharlie* ]] || exit 94
'

files.slabinfo:
slabinfo - version: 2.1
# name active_objs num_objs objsize objperslab pagesperslab : tunables limit batchcount sharedfactor : slabdata active_slabs num_slabs sharedavail
fxalpha 0 9 100 4 2 : tunables 0 0 0 : slabdata 2 8 0
fxbeta 1 3 400 2 1 : tunables 0 0 0 : slabdata 0 3 0
fxcharlie 2 6 700 4 3 : tunables 0 0 0 : slabdata 4 5 0

cases.oracle: Pinned procps 4.0.4 slabtop -o with the identical controlled /proc/slabinfo; a fresh unprivileged mount namespace and byte-equality control prove the bind, and the reference table must name all three distinctive fixture caches.
cases.comparison: Exact reference/candidate stdout, stderr, status and tree; default and every sort key have separate cases, and malformed/zero/rounding variants do not depend on a preceding case.
